zh.name: 计算器
zh.summary: 从日常四则运算开始，也可以切换科学计算与程序员模式。键盘、数字按钮和结果区组成一个紧凑的工具窗口。
steps: 输入数字和运算符，查看表达式与结果。
用 Basic / Scientific / Programmer 切换计算模式。
清空当前输入，开始下一次计算。
zh.requirements: 基础运算不需要业务后台；需要对应的 AutoUI 运行环境。
zh.state: 它是计算工具与输入交互示例；不同模式的运算覆盖以对应版本实现为准。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 基础计算模式。

en.name: Calculator
en.summary: A compact tool for everyday arithmetic, with scientific and programmer modes available from the same window.
steps: Enter numbers and operators to inspect the expression and result.
Switch between Basic, Scientific, and Programmer modes.
Clear the current input and start a new calculation.
en.requirements: Basic arithmetic needs an AutoUI runtime and no application backend.
en.state: This introduces calculator input and modes; operator coverage depends on the implementation version.
en.caption: Native VM window · basic calculation mode.

zh.name: 时钟
zh.summary: 把时钟、世界时钟、闹钟、秒表与计时器放在一个应用中。桌面小组件让时间信息可以在窗口之外持续查看。
steps: 查看本地时间与日期。
切换到世界时钟、闹钟、秒表或计时器。
在桌面形态下保持应用运行，并最小化窗口查看小组件。
zh.requirements: 计时需要应用保持运行；小组件需要 AutoOS 桌面宿主。
zh.state: 独立时钟窗口与桌面小组件是两种呈现方式，小组件当前需打开应用后才显示。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 运行时的本地时间。

en.name: Clock
en.summary: Clock, world time, alarms, stopwatch, and timer share one application. A desktop widget keeps time visible outside its main window.
steps: Inspect the local time and date.
Select world time, alarms, stopwatch, or timer.
In the desktop runtime, keep the app running and minimize it to see its widget.
en.requirements: Timers require a running application; desktop widgets require the AutoOS host.
en.state: The standalone window and desktop widget are separate presentations. The widget currently appears after launching the application.
en.caption: Native VM window · local time at capture.

zh.name: 待办
zh.summary: 用一张任务列表管理日常事项：新增、完成、筛选，再清理已完成项目。它也展示前端状态如何与应用后端联动。
steps: 在输入框中添加一项任务。
勾选完成状态，切换全部、未完成和已完成列表。
检查剩余数量，按需清理已完成任务。
zh.requirements: 需要任务后端或支持应用后端逻辑的本地 VM 运行环境。
zh.state: 截图使用应用内置任务数据；不会向访问这个介绍页的人提供跨设备任务同步。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 应用内置的四条示例任务。

en.name: Tasks
en.summary: A task list for adding, completing, filtering, and clearing everyday items. It also introduces application state connected to a backend.
steps: Add a task using the input field.
Toggle completion and switch between all, active, and completed items.
Inspect the remaining count and clear completed items when needed.
en.requirements: Requires the task backend or a local VM runtime that executes its backend logic.
en.state: The capture uses application seed tasks. This introduction page does not provide cross-device task synchronization.
en.caption: Native VM window · four built-in example tasks.

zh.name: 天气
zh.summary: 按城市浏览当前天气、小时变化与天气指标。图标、信息层级和桌面小组件用于解释一组天气数据。
steps: 选择城市，查看温度与天气概况。
阅读小时预报、湿度、风速等指标。
在桌面宿主中打开应用后查看天气小组件。
zh.requirements: 当前内置天气数据可离线展示；小组件依赖 AutoOS 宿主。
zh.state: 当前数据是演示天气，不能用于判断实时天气或出行条件。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 北京的内置演示天气。

en.name: Weather
en.summary: City weather, hourly changes, and related measurements introduce information layout and desktop widgets.
steps: Select a city and inspect its temperature and overview.
Read hourly conditions, humidity, wind, and other measurements.
Launch the app in the desktop host to display its weather widget.
en.requirements: Built-in weather data can be shown offline; the widget requires the AutoOS host.
en.state: The current data is demonstration weather, not a live weather feed or travel forecast.
en.caption: Native VM window · built-in demonstration weather for Beijing.

zh.name: 便笺
zh.summary: 用列表和正文编辑区记录短笔记，按文件夹、标签或置顶状态组织内容。适合轻量记录，也展示列表选择与编辑状态。
steps: 从左侧列表选择一条便笺。
修改标题与正文，或新建记录。
用文件夹、标签和置顶入口整理已有便笺。
zh.requirements: 需要便笺后端或本地 VM 后端逻辑；持久化行为以运行形态为准。
zh.state: 它是短笔记应用；页面关系与知识库工作由 JadeEdit 的独立介绍说明。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 内置便笺与编辑区。

en.name: Notes
en.summary: Short notes combine a list and a text editor, with folders, tags, and pinning for organization.
steps: Choose a note from the left-hand list.
Edit its title and body or create another note.
Organize notes using folders, tags, and pinning.
en.requirements: Requires the notes backend or local VM backend logic; persistence depends on the runtime.
en.state: This is a short-note application. Page relationships and knowledge-base work are described separately for JadeEdit.
en.caption: Native VM window · built-in notes and editing area.

zh.name: 日历
zh.summary: 用月历查看日期、前后切换月份，并保留当前选择。简洁的日期网格适合日常查阅，也可用于理解日期选择组件。
steps: 查看当前展示的月份。
用左右箭头切换月份，选择一个日期。
通过 Today 返回应用的今日定位。
zh.requirements: 基础月历不需要业务后台；桌面小组件依赖宿主与运行中的应用。
zh.state: 这是月历与日期选择示例，截图中的选定日期来自应用示例初始状态；未将它介绍为完整日程协作服务。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 示例初始月份与选定日期。

en.name: Calendar
en.summary: A month grid for looking up dates, switching months, and keeping the current selection.
steps: Inspect the displayed month.
Move between months and select a date.
Use Today to return to the application’s current-day location.
en.requirements: The month view needs no business backend; a desktop widget needs the host and a running app.
en.state: This introduces a calendar and date selection. The captured initial month is sample state, not a full collaborative scheduling service.
en.caption: Native VM window · initial sample month and selected date.

zh.name: 聊天
zh.summary: 联系人、消息记录与输入区组成一个即时通信界面示例。它用应用自己的后端解释会话选择、发消息与事件更新。
steps: 选择联系人，阅读对应会话。
输入消息或选择快捷回复，再发送。
观察消息列表与联系人摘要的变化。
zh.requirements: 需要聊天 API；事件通知还依赖对应的流服务与运行形态。
zh.state: 联系人与对话是内置演示内容；AutoBot 标签不代表已接入真实模型服务，也没有连接微信网络。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口连接实际聊天后端 · 内置联系人与消息。

en.name: Chat
en.summary: Contacts, message history, and an input area introduce a messaging interface connected to its own application backend.
steps: Select a contact and read the conversation.
Enter a message or choose a quick reply, then send it.
Observe changes to the conversation and contact summary.
en.requirements: Requires the chat API; event notifications also need the corresponding streaming service and runtime support.
en.state: Contacts and messages are built-in examples. The AutoBot label does not establish a live model connection, and this app is not connected to WeChat.
en.caption: Native VM window connected to the actual chat backend · built-in contacts and messages.

zh.name: 图书阅读器
zh.summary: 从书架进入图书、章节和阅读设置。书目、进度与阅读页面组成一个可导航的阅读应用结构。
steps: 在书架中选择一本书。
进入章节，阅读正文并切换章节。
查看阅读进度与设置，再返回书架。
zh.requirements: 需要图书和章节 API；本地示例后端提供内置书目与正文。
zh.state: 截图是应用内置书架，不代表已经提供在线书城或通用电子书导入。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口连接实际阅读后端 · 三本示例图书。

en.name: Book reader
en.summary: A library leads into books, chapters, and reading settings, introducing navigation and reading progress.
steps: Select a book from the library.
Open a chapter, read its text, and move between chapters.
Inspect progress and settings, then return to the library.
en.requirements: Requires book and chapter APIs; the local example backend supplies built-in books and text.
en.state: The capture shows the built-in library. It does not establish an online bookstore or general ebook import.
en.caption: Native VM window connected to the actual reading backend · three sample books.

zh.name: 博客阅读器
zh.summary: 按分类浏览文章、进入正文，并查看作者等信息。阅读列表与文章页面也可以用于学习内容应用的组织方式。
steps: 从文章列表选择主题或分类。
进入文章正文，阅读作者与内容。
返回列表，继续查看其他文章。
zh.requirements: 需要文章后端或本地 VM 后端逻辑。
zh.state: 内容来自内置示例文章，页面不是外部博客聚合服务；写作等入口以具体版本实现为准。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 内置文章列表。

en.name: Blog reader
en.summary: Browse articles by category and open their text and author information. The list and article views introduce a content application.
steps: Choose a topic or category from the article list.
Open an article and read its author information and text.
Return to the list to explore another article.
en.requirements: Requires the article backend or local VM backend logic.
en.state: Content comes from built-in articles rather than an external blog aggregation service; writing features depend on the version.
en.caption: Native VM window · built-in article list.

zh.name: 视频社区示例
zh.summary: 用视频卡片、分类和观看页面组织内容。它展示类似视频门户的页面结构，与直接打开本地文件的视频播放器分开介绍。
steps: 在首页浏览视频卡片与分类。
选择一条内容进入观看页面。
查看内容信息，再返回首页。
zh.requirements: 列表和内容信息需要应用后端；真正播放还需要有效媒体资源与解码能力。
zh.state: 截图中的标题与卡片来自内置数据，只记录内容浏览界面，不证明每条视频都能播放。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 内置视频内容卡片。

en.name: Video community example
en.summary: Video cards, categories, and watch pages introduce a portal-style content application, distinct from the local-file video player.
steps: Browse video cards and categories on the home page.
Choose an item to open its watch page.
Inspect its information and return to the home page.
en.requirements: Lists and metadata need the application backend; playback additionally needs valid media and decoding support.
en.state: The capture shows built-in titles and cards. It records content browsing, not successful playback of every listed video.
en.caption: Native VM window · built-in video content cards.

zh.name: 音乐播放器
zh.summary: 扫描本地音乐，结合曲库、播放队列与唱片舞台查看当前曲目。媒体数据和播放控制在同一界面中呈现。
steps: 配置可访问的媒体目录并扫描曲库。
选择一首曲目，查看标题、格式与播放位置。
用播放控制、队列和音量入口安排收听。
zh.requirements: 需要实际媒体扫描/流服务、音频文件和运行形态支持的播放能力。
zh.state: 截图使用本地 WAV 测试音频；界面上的 Hi-Res 文案不能作为文件实际采样率或音质的证明。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口连接真实媒体扫描服务 · 本地 WAV 测试曲目。

en.name: Music player
en.summary: Local music scanning, a library, queue, and record stage present tracks and playback controls together.
steps: Configure an accessible media directory and scan the library.
Select a track to inspect its title, format, and position.
Use playback controls, the queue, and volume to organize listening.
en.requirements: Needs the real media scanning/streaming service, audio files, and playback support in the chosen runtime.
en.state: The capture uses a local WAV test tone. The Hi-Res interface label is not evidence of the file’s sample rate or audio quality.
en.caption: Native VM window connected to the real media scan service · local WAV test track.

zh.name: 照片图库
zh.summary: 直接扫描配置目录，用照片网格浏览图片和子目录，再进入大图查看。搜索、排序、密度与收藏帮助整理浏览过程。
steps: 配置照片根目录，让后端扫描真实图片。
选择子目录或搜索关键词，调整网格密度与排序。
打开大图，前后查看或收藏，再返回网格。
zh.requirements: 需要照片扫描、缩略图和原图服务，以及有访问权限的本地图片目录。
zh.state: 当前目录逐层浏览，收藏可跨目录聚合。截图扫描的是公开 AutoOS 截图文件，不使用私人照片。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口连接实际照片服务 · 扫描三张公开 AutoOS 截图。

en.name: Photo gallery
en.summary: Scan a configured directory, browse images and subdirectories in a grid, then open a larger view with search, sorting, density, and favorites.
steps: Configure a photo root and let the backend scan real images.
Choose a subdirectory or search term and adjust density or sorting.
Open an image, move between images or favorite it, then return to the grid.
en.requirements: Requires scan, thumbnail, and full-image services plus an accessible local image directory.
en.state: Browsing proceeds directory by directory; favorites can span directories. The capture scans public AutoOS screenshots rather than personal photos.
en.caption: Native VM window connected to the actual photo service · three public AutoOS screenshot files.

zh.name: 视频播放器
zh.summary: 以本地视频为中心，用大视口、进度条和播放队列控制观看。它与视频社区示例的内容门户用途不同。
steps: 扫描本地媒体目录，或选择可播放的视频文件。
打开视频，使用进度条定位到需要的位置。
调整音量、倍速或队列，并在需要时收起侧栏。
zh.requirements: 需要真实媒体文件与扫描/流服务；Vue 使用浏览器解码，原生视频能力还取决于 libmpv 等运行库。
zh.state: 图中真实解码的是本地 WebM 测试片段。Vue 画面不等于已经验证所有原生格式与播放能力。
zh.caption: Vue 运行界面 · 实际读取并定位本地 WebM 测试视频。

en.name: Video player
en.summary: A large viewport, timeline, and queue focus on local video playback, separate from the video community example.
steps: Scan a local media directory or choose a playable video file.
Open the video and seek to the desired position.
Adjust volume, speed, or queue options and collapse the sidebar as needed.
en.requirements: Needs real media and scanning/streaming services. Vue uses browser decoding; native playback additionally depends on libraries such as libmpv.
en.state: The capture decodes a local WebM test clip. A Vue capture does not verify every native format or playback capability.
en.caption: Vue runtime · a real local WebM test video opened and positioned.

zh.name: 图片查看器
zh.summary: 打开图片或目录，以适应窗口、缩放、旋转与前后导航检查图像。侧栏呈现文件选择，大视口负责查看。
steps: 打开图片或目录，选中一张图像。
使用适应窗口、1:1 或缩放控制查看细节。
旋转或平移图像，再切换到相邻文件。
zh.requirements: 需要可访问的图片文件；支持格式与解码能力以对应运行库为准。
zh.state: 它用于查看而非修图；截图打开源码测试目录中的 scenic-320x240.png。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 实际打开 320×240 测试图像。

en.name: Image viewer
en.summary: Open an image or directory and inspect it using fit, zoom, rotation, and navigation in a large viewport.
steps: Open an image or directory and select an image.
Use fit, 1:1, or zoom controls to inspect details.
Rotate or pan the image, then move to a neighboring file.
en.requirements: Requires accessible image files; supported formats and decoding depend on the runtime libraries.
en.state: This is a viewer rather than an image editor. The capture opens scenic-320x240.png from the source test fixtures.
en.caption: Native VM window · a real 320×240 test image opened.

zh.name: 像素画板
zh.summary: 在 16×16 网格上逐格绘制，用画笔、橡皮、填充和取色器组织一幅小型像素画。颜色与历史操作都在应用状态中维护。
steps: 选择颜色，用画笔点击网格绘制。
切换橡皮、填充或取色器调整图案。
撤销、重做，或保存并重新载入画板。
zh.requirements: 本地交互不需要业务后台；保存依赖运行形态提供的 Storage。
zh.state: 当前以点击逐格绘制为主，不将它介绍为已有连续拖画和通用图像导出的绘图软件。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 通过真实点击绘制的网格图案。

en.name: Pixel paint
en.summary: Draw cell by cell on a 16×16 grid with pencil, eraser, fill, and picker tools, with colors and history kept in application state.
steps: Choose a color and click grid cells to draw.
Switch to eraser, fill, or picker to adjust the pattern.
Undo, redo, or save and reload the canvas.
en.requirements: Local interaction needs no business backend; saving uses the runtime’s Storage support.
en.state: The current interaction is cell clicking. This is not presented as continuous drag painting or a general image-export editor.
en.caption: Native VM window · a grid pattern drawn through real clicks.

zh.name: 系统监视器
zh.summary: 查看 CPU、内存与进程等系统信息。独立窗口与桌面小组件把较完整的监控视图和简短状态显示分开。
steps: 查看资源使用概况。
进入进程或资源面板，检查具体条目。
在桌面中保持应用运行并最小化，以查看监控小组件。
zh.requirements: 需要宿主系统采样能力；不同平台的可用指标可能不同。
zh.state: 截图采样的是拍摄机器当时的状态，不是网站访客设备的信息。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 拍摄机器的实际资源采样。

en.name: System monitor
en.summary: Inspect CPU, memory, and process information in a full window, with a compact desktop widget for ongoing status.
steps: Read the resource usage overview.
Inspect process or resource panels for details.
Keep the app running and minimize it in the desktop to display its monitoring widget.
en.requirements: Requires host system sampling; available measurements vary across platforms.
en.state: The capture records the capture machine at that moment, not the website visitor’s device.
en.caption: Native VM window · actual capture-machine resource samples.

zh.name: 数据库界面示例
zh.summary: 用树状结构浏览表与字段，再查看记录、编辑入口和查询面板。它展示数据工具的工作台结构。
steps: 从数据库树选择一张表。
查看列、记录和数据编辑入口。
切换到查询面板，观察查询输入与结果的组织方式。
zh.requirements: 示例数据可在应用中展示；实际数据库连接、执行与持久化需要相应后端实现。
zh.state: 截图使用内置 Northwind 风格数据；SQLite 标题、查询与事务入口不证明已连到真实 SQLite 数据库，事务部分含模拟行为。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 内置表结构与示例记录。

en.name: Database interface example
en.summary: A database tree, records, editing controls, and query panel introduce the structure of a data workspace.
steps: Choose a table from the database tree.
Inspect columns, records, and editing controls.
Switch to the query panel to inspect input and result layout.
en.requirements: The application can display sample data; real connections, execution, and persistence need their corresponding backend.
en.state: The capture uses built-in Northwind-style data. SQLite labels and query/transaction controls do not prove a real database connection; transaction behavior includes simulation.
en.caption: Native VM window · built-in table structure and sample records.

zh.name: 文件管理器
zh.summary: 从目录导航进入列表或网格，按名称、大小和时间查找文件。文件操作与路径状态围绕真实文件系统组织。
steps: 通过地址栏打开一个可访问的目录。
切换列表或网格，按需排序、搜索和显示隐藏项。
选择文件查看信息；执行改名、复制或删除前检查目标路径。
zh.requirements: 真实读写需要文件系统能力和目录权限；Vue 需要对应文件 API。
zh.state: 截图浏览专用测试目录的真实文件。带有文件接口的本地运行与静态网页里的演示后备状态分开说明。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 专用媒体测试目录的真实文件。

en.name: File manager
en.summary: Navigate directories in list or grid form and find files by name, size, or date, with operations organized around a real filesystem.
steps: Open an accessible directory using the address bar.
Switch list/grid views and use sorting, search, or hidden-file controls.
Inspect selected files and check target paths before rename, copy, or delete operations.
en.requirements: Real reads and writes require filesystem capabilities and permissions; Vue needs the corresponding file API.
en.state: The capture browses real files in a dedicated fixture directory. Local filesystem use is distinct from static-web fallback demonstration state.
en.caption: Native VM window · real files in a dedicated media fixture directory.

zh.name: 应用启动器
zh.summary: 集中查找和启动应用，用列表或图标视图组织入口。桌面版本从宿主注册表读取应用，独立示例用于展示启动器交互。
steps: 打开启动器。
输入关键词，或切换到图标视图浏览应用。
选择应用启动，再返回已有桌面窗口。
zh.requirements: 真正启动应用需要 AutoOS 桌面宿主、应用注册与对应运行能力。
zh.state: 本页主图来自已拍摄的桌面启动器。独立 028 示例的数据与当前桌面应用注册表并不完全相同。
zh.caption: AutoOS VM 虚拟桌面 · 图标形式的真实启动器。

en.name: Application launcher
en.summary: Find and launch applications in list or icon form. The desktop version uses the host registry; the standalone example introduces launcher interaction.
steps: Open the launcher.
Search by keyword or browse applications in icon view.
Choose an application to launch and return to existing desktop windows.
en.requirements: Actual launching requires the AutoOS desktop host, application registration, and the relevant runtime capabilities.
en.state: The main image is an existing desktop launcher capture. The standalone 028 example’s data is not identical to the current desktop registry.
en.caption: AutoOS VM virtual desktop · actual launcher in icon view.

zh.name: 系统日志
zh.summary: 把时间、来源、等级和消息组成可筛选的日志列表。桌面宿主可以将系统与应用事件接入同一查看器。
steps: 查看日志时间、来源与等级。
按等级或关键词筛选消息。
回到完整列表，持续观察运行中的事件。
zh.requirements: 真实宿主日志需要桌面注入的日志源；独立示例可展示内置记录。
zh.state: 本次截图是独立运行的三条演示日志，图中也标为 mock；它们不是操作系统实际故障或实时宿主事件。
zh.caption: VM 独立窗口 · 应用内置的三条演示日志。

en.name: System log
en.summary: A filterable list combines time, source, level, and message. The desktop host can supply system and application events.
steps: Inspect log times, sources, and levels.
Filter messages by level or keyword.
Return to the complete list and observe running events.
en.requirements: Real host logs need a desktop-injected log source; standalone mode can display built-in records.
en.state: This standalone capture contains three demonstration records labeled mock. They are not actual operating-system failures or live host events.
en.caption: Standalone VM window · three built-in demonstration log records.

zh.name: AutoTerm 终端
zh.summary: 为桌面应用提供通用终端窗口，在标签页与分屏中运行宿主 Shell 或其他交互程序。它承载终端会话，AutoShell 则提供命令语言与执行引擎。
steps: 打开终端，进入配置的 Shell 会话。
新建标签页，按需要横向或纵向分屏。
在活动窗格中输入命令，查看输出与滚动记录。
zh.requirements: 原生交互需要 autoterm-core、平台 PTY 与配置的 Shell；Vue 视口当前为只读形态。
zh.state: 复用已有原生验证图，记录当时的 Windows 命令会话；截图版本与当前源码分开记录，不把它当作新的全部功能验收。
zh.caption: 原生验证资料 · Windows Shell 会话（2026-09-22 留存图）。

en.name: AutoTerm terminal
en.summary: A general desktop terminal runs host shells and interactive programs in tabs and split panes. AutoTerm hosts terminal sessions; AutoShell supplies a command language and engine.
steps: Open the terminal into its configured shell.
Create another tab and split panes horizontally or vertically as needed.
Enter commands in the active pane and inspect output and scrollback.
en.requirements: Native interaction needs autoterm-core, platform PTY support, and a configured shell. The Vue viewport is currently read-only.
en.state: An existing native verification image records a Windows command session. Its capture version is tracked separately from current sources and is not a new full feature acceptance.
en.caption: Native verification material · Windows shell session (retained 2026-09-22 image).

zh.name: AutoOS 配置
zh.summary: 用图形界面组织 AutoOS 与 AI 工具的配置，例如模型、角色、Agent、技能与主题。它让配置项可以按用途查找和管理。
steps: 选择要配置的模块。
查看已有条目与对应配置字段。
修改后按应用提供的保存方式写回，再让使用方读取配置。
zh.requirements: 读写需要配置文件权限；模型、Agent 和守护进程的运行需要各自服务。
zh.state: 复用网站已有技能管理实拍图。配置界面里存在条目不等于对应服务已运行或模型已连通。
zh.caption: 已有原生实拍资料 · 技能配置列表。

en.name: AutoOS settings
en.summary: A graphical workspace organizes AutoOS and AI-tool settings such as models, roles, agents, skills, and themes.
steps: Select the configuration module to manage.
Inspect existing entries and their fields.
Save changes using the application’s controls, then let the consuming tool read them.
en.requirements: Read/write operations require configuration-file permissions; models, agents, and daemons need their own services.
en.state: This reuses the website’s existing skills-management capture. An entry in settings does not establish a running service or model connection.
en.caption: Existing native capture material · skills configuration list.

zh.name: 俄罗斯方块
zh.summary: 用下落方块、旋转、移动和落下组织一个实时小游戏。分数、等级与下一块信息围绕棋盘呈现。
steps: 开始游戏，观察当前方块和下一块。
用方向键移动和旋转，按界面提示快速落下。
暂停或重新开始，查看得分与记录。
zh.requirements: 游戏需要持续计时与键盘输入；记录功能需要对应存储或后端。
zh.state: 截图是真实启动后的棋盘状态，运行中的方块位置会随时间变化。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 开始游戏后的实际棋盘。

en.name: Tetris
en.summary: Falling blocks, rotation, movement, and dropping introduce a real-time game, with score, level, and next-piece information around the board.
steps: Start the game and inspect the current and next pieces.
Move and rotate with the keys shown by the interface, then drop a piece.
Pause or restart and inspect scores and records.
en.requirements: Requires continuous timing and keyboard input; records use the corresponding storage or backend.
en.state: The capture shows an actual started game. Piece positions change as the game runs.
en.caption: Native VM window · actual board after starting a game.

zh.name: 纸牌接龙
zh.summary: 在牌堆、桌面列与收集区之间移动纸牌，按接龙规则整理一副牌。窗口中也有撤销、重开与外观设置入口。
steps: 开始一局，观察桌面列与发牌堆。
点击发牌或按规则移动纸牌。
撤销一步、重新发牌，或查看游戏记录。
zh.requirements: 基本游戏需要 AutoUI 运行环境；记录的持久化取决于对应后端或存储。
zh.state: 主图是真实发牌后的窗口，不将一张截图当作整局胜利或全部规则验证。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 实际发牌后的接龙牌桌。

en.name: Solitaire
en.summary: Move cards between stock, tableau, and foundations using Klondike rules, with undo, restart, and appearance controls.
steps: Start a game and inspect the tableau and stock.
Draw cards or move them according to the rules.
Undo a move, deal again, or inspect game records.
en.requirements: Basic play needs an AutoUI runtime; persistent records depend on its backend or storage.
en.state: The main image shows an actual dealt board. It does not establish a completed game or full rule verification.
en.caption: Native VM window · actual dealt Klondike board.

zh.name: 扫雷
zh.summary: 通过数字线索打开安全格、标记地雷，按难度调整棋盘。计时和剩余标记数帮助查看当前局面。
steps: 选择初级、中级或高级棋盘。
打开一个格子，按线索继续探索。
用标记动作标出可疑格，必要时重新开始。
zh.requirements: 基本游戏不需要外部服务；鼠标操作与标记方式以当前界面提示为准。
zh.state: 主图显示一局打开安全区域后的真实棋盘。难度与首步安全等行为由应用实现提供。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 实际打开格子后的初级棋盘。

en.name: Minesweeper
en.summary: Open safe cells and mark mines using numerical clues, with difficulty, timer, and remaining-marker information.
steps: Choose an easy, medium, or hard board.
Open a cell and continue using its clues.
Mark suspect cells or start another game when needed.
en.requirements: Basic play needs no external service; pointer and marking gestures follow the current interface.
en.state: The capture shows a real beginner board after opening a safe area. Difficulty and first-move behavior come from the application.
en.caption: Native VM window · actual beginner board with cells opened.

zh.name: 看板示例
zh.summary: 用工作区、列和卡片整理任务状态，理解任务从一个阶段进入下一阶段的过程。它也是较完整的应用界面结构示例。
steps: 选择工作区或看板。
查看不同列中的卡片，进入任务详情。
调整任务内容或状态，观察看板变化。
zh.requirements: 需要示例后端或本地 VM 后端逻辑。
zh.state: 这是 022-kanban 示例，与独立的 auto-kanban 产品工程分开介绍；截图使用内置工作区数据。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 内置工作区与任务卡片。

en.name: Kanban example
en.summary: Workspaces, columns, and cards organize task states and introduce how a task moves between stages.
steps: Select a workspace or board.
Inspect cards in different columns and open task details.
Adjust task content or state and observe the board.
en.requirements: Requires the example backend or local VM backend logic.
en.state: This is the 022-kanban example, distinct from the separate auto-kanban product project. The capture uses built-in workspace data.
en.caption: Native VM window · built-in workspace and task cards.

zh.name: RealWorld 应用示例
zh.summary: 用文章社区的结构展示路由、账号入口、文章列表与详情。多页面与前后端数据链比单个组件更接近完整应用。
steps: 在 Global Feed 浏览文章与标签。
进入一篇文章，查看内容与评论入口。
按需要研究登录、写作等路由及其后端契约。
zh.requirements: 需要 RealWorld API；账号与内容操作使用示例后端，不连接公开社区。
zh.state: 主图来自连接真实示例后端的 Vue 运行，文章为内置内容。其他运行形态的覆盖需单独验证。
zh.caption: Vue 画廊运行连接实际后端 · 内置文章与标签。

en.name: RealWorld application example
en.summary: An article-community structure introduces routing, account entry points, feeds, and details, connecting multiple pages to backend data.
steps: Browse articles and tags in Global Feed.
Open an article and inspect its content and comment entry point.
Study sign-in and writing routes and their backend contracts as needed.
en.requirements: Requires the RealWorld API; account and content operations use the example backend rather than a public community.
en.state: The main capture is a Vue runtime connected to the actual example backend with built-in articles. Other runtime coverage needs separate verification.
en.caption: Vue gallery runtime connected to its actual backend · built-in articles and tags.

zh.name: 图表工坊
zh.summary: 在同一工作台中切换图表类型、数据系列和展示形态，观察数据与图形之间的关系。适合研究图表组件的配置与状态。
steps: 选择折线、柱形等图表类型。
切换数据系列与桌面/移动/平板展示设置。
播放或重置示例数据，观察图表更新。
zh.requirements: 当前工作台使用本地示例数据；实时业务数据需要应用另行接入。
zh.state: 主图展示的是内置销售等示例系列，不是项目真实经营指标。
zh.caption: VM 原生窗口 · 本地示例数据绘制的折线图。

en.name: Chart workshop
en.summary: Switch chart types, series, and presentation settings to explore how data and graphics relate in a configurable workspace.
steps: Select a chart type such as line or bar.
Change series and desktop/mobile/tablet presentation settings.
Play or reset example data and observe updates.
en.requirements: The current workshop uses local sample data; live business data requires separate integration.
en.state: The capture shows built-in example series rather than real project business measurements.
en.caption: Native VM window · line chart rendered from local sample data.
